when: Player card · the VA+ figure
text: VA+ = VA + defensive net over possessions played: «DRTG» DRTG vs team «team DRTG» + «w»% of team's edge vs league «league DRTG» (plus edges earned by stock rate; minus edges shrink with activity: 40% − earned) — «team» rated «x» across the season, carried at «w»% for the share of it he played and the rest at the league line

when: Player card · the VA+ figure, when there's no team line
text: VA+ = VA + defensive net rating («DRTG» DRTG vs «league» league) over the possessions played

when: Category context card · each stat tile above the scatter
text: «Stat» — collapse the plot onto this stat and filter the card / «Stat» — back to the scatter

when: Category context card · Defense scatter, the team line
text: The team defense «player» is measured against («DRTG» DRTG vs «league» league) — he lands right of this line when he defends better than it — «team» rated «x» across the season, carried at «w»% for the share of it he played and the rest at the league line

when: Category context card · /G toggle

when: Category context card · shooting total
text: «Category» value added per game — the bars below, summed

when: Category context card · Eff and Impact tiles
text: Efficiency — 3-point + 2-point + free-throw value added per game (the scoring rows' shooting value) — tap to rank the card on it / Relative impact — the six shot-distance values below, summed (per game) — tap to rank the card on it

when: Category context card · each shot-distance column
text: «Stat» («distance») — filter the card to this distance / stat

when: Category context card · Seasons / Careers switch
text: Ranking whole careers, career value added per career game / every season summed — tap to rank single «scope» seasons instead / Ranking single «scope» seasons — tap to rank whole careers instead

when: Compare picker · “Closest comps · by decade” label
text: Ranked by how close the season is AND how close it sits to the same point in a career — this one is your career year «n». Only seasons built out of the same parts of the game are eligible at all, so a decade with nothing comparable in it is left out rather than filled. Hover a comp for the career year it came from.

when: Compare picker · Box Score VA metric button
text: Box Score VA — impact (how close their overall per-game VA level is) × similarity (cosine match of the two VA-by-category profiles), then discounted for landing at a different point in a career — each chip's tooltip names both sides. Only seasons that draw their value from the same parts of the game are eligible: offense vs defense first, then scoring vs passing and rebounding vs rim protection, then the categories themselves

when: Compare picker · Shooting metric button
text: Shooting — cosine × magnitude match of the two shooting profiles (4 shot-distance zones + 3-Pointers + Free Throws; needs zone data, 1996-97+), then discounted for landing at a different point in a career — each chip's tooltip names both sides

when: Compare picker · the season the card is already showing

when: Run compare picker · “Closest runs · by decade” label
